title: SparkLab account windows
subtitle: Partition, order and hot-key limits
description: Compute prior amounts and running balances over real shared catalog rows, then compare fictional profiles and AQE. A hot ordered account cannot be split safely.
scale_note: Authored 9.7 GiB / 61,840,000-row scenario, not a real cluster benchmark.

steps.title: Previous amount and running balance
steps.code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql import Window
w = Window.partitionBy("account_id").orderBy("transaction_ts")
result = (spark.table("silver.transactions")
    .withColumn("previous_amount", F.lag("amount").over(w))
    .withColumn("running_net", F.sum("amount").over(w.rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow))))
steps.solution:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql import Window
w = Window.partitionBy("account_id").orderBy("transaction_ts")
result = (spark.table("silver.transactions")
    .withColumn("previous_amount", F.lag("amount").over(w))
    .withColumn("running_net", F.sum("amount").over(w.rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow))))
steps.concept: Window partition exchange and sort; AQE cannot split a single ordered key
steps.task: Compute previous_amount and running_net per account in timestamp order. Compare Small and Generic profiles, then AQE off/on.
steps.hint: Use an explicit ROWS frame for the running sum.
